latest_release.name: v1.16.0
latest_release.body:
### Added

- Added a `normalization` field to `CartesiaTTSService.Settings` and `CartesiaHttpTTSService.Settings`, passing Cartesia's text normalization mode (`"auto"`, `"off"`, or a locale code such as `"en-GB"`) through to synthesis requests.
  (PR [#5430](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5430))

- Added `SarvamHttpSTTService`, which sends each VAD speech segment to Sarvam's REST speech-to-text API (`saaras:v4` by default, or `saaras:v3`) and yields the transcription from `run_stt()`. It takes the same `mode` and `keyterms` options as `SarvamSTTService`, and sends a segment longer than the API's 30-second limit as consecutive pieces whose transcripts are joined.

    ```python
    stt = SarvamHttpSTTService(
        api_key=os.getenv("SARVAM_API_KEY"),
        settings=SarvamHttpSTTService.Settings(language=Language.HI_IN),
    )
    ```
  (PR [#5501](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5501))

- Added `max_speakers` and `filter_profanity` to `AssemblyAISTTService.Settings`, passing AssemblyAI's speaker-label cap and profanity filter through to the streaming session.
  (PR [#5530](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5530))

- `CartesiaSTTService.Settings` now exposes Cartesia's `min_volume` and `max_silence_duration_secs`, which control the silence that triggers automatic transcript finalization on ink-whisper models.
  (PR [#5531](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5531))

- Added `speed` to Inworld Realtime's `AudioOutput`, so a session can set the agent's speaking rate.
  (PR [#5541](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5541))

- Added `noise_reduction` to Inworld Realtime's `AudioInput`, so a session can enable Inworld's near-field or far-field input filter.
  (PR [#5541](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5541))

- Added `threshold`, `prefix_padding_ms`, `silence_duration_ms` and `idle_timeout_ms` to Inworld Realtime's `TurnDetection`, so `type="server_vad"` sessions can be tuned the way Inworld documents.
  (PR [#5541](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5541))

- Added `language` and `prompts` to Inworld Realtime's `InputTranscription`, so a session can pin the STT language and list expected words or phrases for the transcriber to recognize.
  (PR [#5541](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5541))

- Added an `instruction` field to `InworldHttpTTSService.Settings`, which passes Inworld's plain-English steering for a request (e.g. `"speak loudly and urgently"`) through to `inworld-tts-2`. The WebSocket API takes steering as inline `[tags]` in the text instead, so `InworldTTSService` ignores the field.
  (PR [#5542](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5542))

- Added `pronunciation_dict` to `MiniMaxHttpTTSService.Settings`, passing MiniMax's `pronunciation_dict.tone` replacements (e.g. `"Pipecat/(ˈpaɪpkæt)"`) through to synthesis requests.
  (PR [#5545](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5545))

- Added a `truncation` field to the OpenAI Realtime `SessionProperties`, which sets what the server does once a long session outgrows the model's input token limit. By default it drops the oldest messages, only as many as each response needs. `TruncationRetentionRatio` drops more at once so truncation happens less often and more input stays in the prompt cache, which OpenAI recommends for lowering the cost of long sessions; `"disabled"` returns an error instead of truncating.
  (PR [#5547](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5547))

- Added `delay`, `keywords` and `languages` to the OpenAI Realtime `InputAudioTranscription` settings, exposing OpenAI's input-transcription latency/accuracy control and transcription hints.
  (PR [#5547](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5547))

- Added `speaker_id`, `length_scale`, `noise_scale` and `noise_w_scale` settings to `PiperTTSService` and `PiperHttpTTSService`, exposing Piper's speaker selection, speaking speed and variability controls.
  (PR [#5551](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/5551))
